programme.title: Forensic Files: Scratching The Surface
programme.desc: The only clue recovered from a shooting is a twelve-guage shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Proof
programme.desc: A serial arsonist starts several fires that cause millions of dollars worth of damage and the deaths of three people. He is discovered, partly through the use of forensic hypnosis.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking the Mold
programme.desc: A three-year-old develops a respiratory condition. His father has Alzheimers. An investigator reveals that their ill health is due to mold in their modern home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Fire
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: Corporate: Remember Day
programme.desc: Matt bearbetar sitt familjetrauma genom att kasta sig in i kontorets helgfest, Christian ifrågasätter sin världsbild, och Jake överväger att lämna firman.

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdjurens jul
programme.desc: Tomten måste döda de onda djuren i South Park och rädda världen efter att de fått Stan att hjälpa dem med födelsen av deras frälsare.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Strike
programme.desc: När Alice vägrar ge killarna ledigt för fejkhögtiden 'halvjul' bestämmer de sig för att strejka för bättre arbetsvillkor.

programme.title: Anthony Jeselnik - Caligula SV
programme.desc: Den mörka favoritprinsen av komedi, Anthony Jeselnik, låter äntligen pöbeln se hans ståupp. "Anthony Jeselnik: Caligula" filmades på Vic Theatre i Chicago och tar sig an ämnen som de flesta inte ens pratar högt om.

programme.title: South Park: En väldigt sugig jul
programme.desc: Kyle och Ike väntar nervöst på Mr Hankey. När han inte dyker upp kallar Kyle samman de andra för ett sent krismöte.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Secret Santa

programme.title: Tosh.0: Black Santa

programme.title: Klovn
programme.desc: Frank fyller 40 och det ska firas på Hotel Josty. Casper har varit hans bästa vän i 11 år och ska vara toastmaster. Men det blir konstig stämning när han i sitt tal erbjuder sperma så att Mia och Frank kan få barn.

programme.title: Klovn: Muffen Fäller
programme.desc: Det lackar mot jul och Mia och Frank ger varandra adventskalender-presenter. Frank får ett par skridskor och orsakar tumult på skridskobanan. Det blir också ett och annat obekvämt besök på kemtvätten.

programme.title: Klovn: Surprise Mia
programme.desc: Iben och Casper ska på brittiska filmgalan BAFTA och hon har med alla sina Louis Vuitton-väskor. Mia tvivlar på Franks kärlek och tänker att han hellre vill vara ihop med någon kändis, så han planerar en överraskning för henne.

programme.title: Klovn: Gotteligott
programme.desc: Casper är deppig och ligger mest i sin säng. Frank köper en videokamera för att muntra upp honom men Casper tycker inte att det händer något värt att filma. Samtidigt blir det stort drama i Mias butik och kameran är nyckeln till allt.

programme.title: Klovn: Shut Up
programme.desc: När Mias butik blir rättvisemärkt träffar Frank en fängslande kvinna. Men raggningsförsöket slutar i att han och Mia får husera en tibetansk flykting. Casper är deprimerad och tycker att han inte får cred för att han hjälpt komikerkollegor.

programme.title: Klovn: De Flätade Skorna Och Ägget
programme.desc: Mia vill skaffa en ny stol men Frank tycker inte att de ska lägga pengar på dyra möbler. Han vill hellre investera i en gräsklippare som ska delas med grannen. När Frank träffar en norsk tjej råkar han utge sig för att vara Muhammed-tecknare.

programme.title: Klovn: Fru Då-och-då
programme.desc: Mia och Frank har flyttat in hos hennes föräldrar men har svårt att hitta tid och plats för varandra. Caspers depression har blivit så allvarlig att han lagts in på sjukhus. Frank måste nu välja mellan att prioritera sex eller sin väns välbefinnande.

programme.title: Klovn: Monsieur Le Boss
programme.desc: Mia bjuder med Frank på en avslappnande spa-weekend på hotell, men det blir trassel med såväl kama sutra som tarmsköljning. Casper rymmer från sjukhuset och Frank måste leta upp honom.

programme.title: Klovn: Bedragsholms Slott
programme.desc: Frank, Mia, Casper och Iben åker på en weekend-tripp till Dragsholms slott, tillsammans med Lars Hjorthøj och hans fru Tina. Kvinnorna ser fram emot en lugn och skön helg, medan grabbarna vill hänga runt och jaga, men allt spårar ur snabbt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MMMMMM
programme.desc: Jordan och Keegan stilar inför en hängiven publik på en lokalteater, en trafikreporter får uppleva turbulens i helikoptern och ena halvan av en R&B-duo avslöjar sina känslor för den andre under ett uppträdande.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Airplane Showdown
programme.desc: En flygvärd måste hantera en passagerare som vägrar sätta på sig bältet, brittiska upptäcktsresande diskuterar sina resor, två par försöker undvika spoilers på en dubbeldejt och en bibelgrupp får uppleva ett gudomligt ingripande.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slappnar av hemma, Keegan måste skärpa sig på en jobbintervju, en skräddare har en kund med gaser, dörrvakterna diskuterar 'Game of Thrones' och en telefonförsäljare testar en ny strategi.

programme.desc: Keegan blir distraherad när han pratar med sin tjej i telefon, Keegan och Jordan har en elak chef och ett nytt uttryck föds.

programme.desc: President Obama och hans vredestolk Luther talar till Mitt Romney, vi träffar mannen som ska hålla tal efter Martin Luther Kings 'Jag har en dröm' och två vänner diskuterar vad som händer med bajset när de spolar.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: South Park: Röd släde nedskjuten

programme.title: South Park: Jul i Kanada

programme.title: Nathan For You: Santa / Petting Zoo
programme.desc: Nathan upptäcker att tomten han brukar hjälpa har en mörk hemlighet. Han försöker marknadsföra en djurpark, med oväntade resultat. Dessutom ertappas en tonåring med att måla graffiti.

programme.desc: Tomten måste döda de onda djuren i South Park och rädda världen efter att de fått Stan att hjälpa dem med födelsen av deras frälsare.

programme.title: iCarly: iDejt - Sam och Freddie
programme.desc: Carly går in för att medla i ett gräl mellan Sam och Freddie. Snart kommer Freddie och Sam till Carly för att få hjälp varenda gång de grälar. När hon nu blivit involverad, hur ska Carly kunna dra sig ur situationen?

programme.title: iCarly: iNTE uthärdligt

programme.title: iCarly: Jag älskar dej
programme.desc: Carly säger åt Sam och Freddie att prova varandras favorithobbies. Under tiden stöter Spencer på sin gamla barnvakt och bjuder ut henne på middag. Efter att de återfallit i sina gamla roller, kommer de att kunna fortsätta vara tillsammans?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly försöker imponera på sin nya pojkvän genom att verka smartare än hon är. Under tiden försöker gänget hitta ett nytt ställe där T-Bo kan bo, efter det att han blivit utsparkad från Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: iMöter rikets första dam
programme.desc: En högt uppsatt statlig myndighet börjar utreda iCarly-gänget efter att de hackat sig in i ett säkerhetsnätverk, för att kunna ge Carlys pappa ett födelsedagskalas online. Gästartist - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: iTån och Fat Cakes

programme.title: iCarly: iSynproblem
programme.desc: Efter att ha blivit "dissad" i en intervju om iCarly, försöker Freddie visa sin kreativa sida genom att webb-sända iCarly i 3D. Spencer anställer en assistent som han inte har råd att betala.

programme.title: iCarly: iTabbar 2: Electric Tabbaloo
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skådespelaren som spelar Rex i Victorious, återvänder för att djup-intervjua stjärnorna i iCarly, och visa deras superroliga tabbar och bortklippta scener. Gästartist: Rex från Victorious.

programme.title: iCarly: iFortfarande galen

programme.title: Matlock: The Haunted (Part 1)

programme.title: Matlock: The Kidnapping (Part 1)
programme.desc: After a failed attempt to kidnap Matlock’s daughter, the kidnappers take Matlock’s friend instead! Matlock tries to track down his friend, meanwhile, he’s asked to investigate the kidnapping of an eight-year-old boy.

programme.title: Matlock: The Temptation

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: It's a strange twist of fate when millionaire William Bissell, checks into the hospital and stumbles upon his ex-lover, Nurse Jenny Morgan. After Bissell's found murdered by lethal injection, Jenny becomes the number one suspect.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: As a favor to a colleague, Dr. Sloan agrees to perform surgery on mafia kingpin Alfred Johnson. A supposed routine heart operation turns into an untimely death for The Don.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Dying of gunshot wounds, private investigator Charlie Harper whispers one final cryptic message to Dr. Sloan. Intrigued, Sloan searches for the meaning of the dying man's last words with the aid of Charlie's secretary, Georgia.

programme.title: Diagnosis Murder
programme.desc: Kill 'em with laughter. That's just what Bonnie Valin did when she murdered her husband with nitrous oxide or laughing gas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Firefighters find an entire family dead inside their home in an apparent murder-suicide, but there are several inconsistent clues in the rubble. Could ballistics, a time card and some secret audiotapes unravel the mystery?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All the World's a Stage
programme.desc: Police are dispatched to the scene of a shooting and discover the victim's husband is one of their own: a homicide detective who says his wife accidentally shot herself in the head.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bound for Jail
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: Anthony Jeselnik - Caligula SV
programme.desc: Den mörka favoritprinsen av komedi, Anthony Jeselnik, låter äntligen pöbeln se hans ståupp. "Anthony Jeselnik: Caligula" filmades på Vic Theatre i Chicago och tar sig an ämnen som de flesta inte ens pratar högt om.

programme.title: South Park: En väldigt sugig jul
programme.desc: Kyle och Ike väntar nervöst på Mr Hankey. När han inte dyker upp kallar Kyle samman de andra för ett sent krismöte.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Secret Santa
programme.desc: What were those strange lights in the desert? Who are these new Reno Sheriff's Department deputies?

programme.title: Tosh.0: Black Santa
programme.desc: I det här julavsnittet tar Daniel reda på vem som sköt den svarte jultomten, visar sin värsta "jag är bättre än dig, bajs i ditt fejs" och avslöjar ett gammalt familjerecept.

programme.title: South Park: God jul, Charlie Manson!
programme.desc: Farbror Howard rymmer från fängelset tillsammans med en annan intern, Charlie Manson. Charlie är redo att njuta av sin frihet men blir distraherad av ett specialinspelat julprogram.

programme.title: South Park: Julesnö
programme.desc: Jultomten stjäl all glädje från stadens julhelg.

programme.title: South Park: Röd släde nedskjuten
programme.desc: Cartman tar jultomten, Mr. Hankey och Jesus till hjälp för att försöka skänka julkänsla till de förtryckta massorna i Irak - allt för att hamna på tomtens lista över snälla barn.

programme.title: South Park: Jul i Kanada
programme.desc: Kyles adopterade bror Ike hämtas tillbaka till Kanada av hans biologiska föräldrar eftersom den nya kanadensiska premiärministern har bestämt att alla barn som adopterats från Kanada måste lämnas tillbaka.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Santa / Petting Zoo
programme.desc: Nathan upptäcker att tomten han brukar hjälpa har en mörk hemlighet. Han försöker marknadsföra en djurpark, med oväntade resultat. Dessutom ertappas en tonåring med att måla graffiti.

programme.title: iCarly: iFortfarande galen
programme.desc: Efter att ha fått veta att Nora Dershlit kan komma att släppas ut ur fängelset, gör iCarly- ungdomarna vad de kan för att se till att deras gamla kidnappare ska förbli bakom galler. Under tiden upptäcker Freddies mamma den verklige T-Bo.

programme.title: iCarly: iGå One Direction
programme.desc: Carly får en smittsam sjukdom och råkar av misstag göra så att en av medlemmarna i bandet One Direction blir sjuk. Under tiden tvingas Spencer träna en liten tjej som avskyr träning.

programme.title: iCarly: iÖppna Restaurang
programme.desc: Gibby öppnar med Sams hjälp en hemlig restaurang i skolans källare. Under tiden designar Spencer en säkerhets-robot för hemmabruk, som plötsligt helt tappar fokus.

programme.title: iCarly: iApril April!
programme.desc: I det här speciella aprilskämt-avsnittet blir Carly och Spencer vräkta, så gänget sitter och tänker tillbaka på sin tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men deras minnen stämmer kanske inte riktigt alltid överens med hur vi minns händelserna.

programme.title: iCarly: iPearbutiken
programme.desc: Freddies nya drömjobb i Pearbutiken förvandlas till en mardröm när Sam också blir anställd. Under tiden försöker Carly bli utbjuden av en annan anställd i Pearbutiken, och Spencer måste jobba frivilligt på den lokala brandstationen.

programme.title: iCarly: iHalvoween
programme.desc: iCarly-gänget håller en"Halvoween"-fest, eftersom de tycker att Halloween borde vara två gånger om året. Men när en utklädd gäst spelar Carly och hennes vänner ett spratt, urartar festen bortom all kontroll.

programme.title: iCarly: iStrid mot Chip
programme.desc: Spencer har en ny ärkefiende, Chucks lillebror, Chip. Freddie reparerar Gibbys leksakspistol och ger den krafter han aldrig kunnat föreställa sig.

programme.title: iCarly: iBlir Portad
programme.desc: När Carly portar T-Bo från hennes och Spencers hem, hämnas han genom att inte släppa in Carly på Groovy Smoothie. Under tiden upptäcker Freddie och Gibby att det finns många fördelar med att spela i ett band... och vissa nackdelar.

programme.title: iCarly: iTappade huvudet i Las Vegas
programme.desc: När Sam får veta att hennes mamma är i fängelse i Vegas, beslutar gänget att ta sina värdefullaste ägodelar, köra till Vegas och pantsätta dem, för att få tillräckligt med pengar för att betala borgen för henne.

programme.title: iCarly: iRäddar Carly
programme.desc: Sams kompis kommer ut från ungdomsfängelset och Sam säger åt alla att hålla sig borta från henne, men Carly lyssnar inte och är snart illa ute. Hemma i våningen hittar Spencer ett par mörkerkikare.

programme.title: iCarly: iChockar världen Del 1
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon bjuder in iCarly-ungdomarna för att uppträda live i hans TV-show i New York. Gänget älskar New York och är i extas över att få vara med i hans program, men i direktsänd TV kan allt hända.

programme.title: Klovn: Tipo Napoli

programme.title: Klovn: Dubbeldipp

programme.title: Klovn: Vila I Frid Mia
programme.desc: Frank har fått en liten depression. Casper har många bra idéer om hur Frank kan bli på bättre humör, och snart är Frank inblandad i både muggmålning och en Silas Holst-musikal. Men räcker det för att pigga upp en medelålders man?

programme.title: Klovn: Mias Måne
programme.desc: Frank och Mia inspireras till att försöka sig på en trekant. En rutinerad Casper övertygar Frank om att det ska vara med en man den första gången.

programme.title: Klovn: B.s.-skalan
programme.desc: Frank överraskar Mia med en romantisk prinsessdag. Den är planlagd in i minsta detalj med hjälp av Casper och B.S. Christiansen. Inget kan gå fel. Men det kan det. Extremt fel.

programme.title: Klovn: Slöseri Med Pingus
programme.desc: Carøe får hjälp med att ta sig ur en nödsituation, ett SOS. Frank lyckas dock på sedvanligt pinsamt manér att vända det till att de i stället alla råkar i trubbel.

programme.title: Klovn: Frank The Prank
programme.desc: Frank och Casper anställer Bo som assistent på kontoret. Båda tycker att de är som gjorda för att åtgärda hans ungdomsapati, men det råder delade meningar om vilken metod som är den rätta.

programme.title: Geordie Shore

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Santa / Petting Zoo
programme.desc: Nathan upptäcker att tomten han brukar hjälpa har en mörk hemlighet. Han försöker marknadsföra en djurpark, med oväntade resultat. Dessutom ertappas en tonåring med att måla graffiti.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julbajskorven
programme.desc: Borgmästaren bestämmer sig för att införa ett oförargligt helgtema som inte väcker anstöt hos någon. Kyle tror att han har svaret.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankeys julklassiker
programme.desc: I det här specialavsnittet visas inslag från Mr Hankeys julalbum.

programme.title: Corporate: Remember Day
programme.desc: Matt bearbetar sitt familjetrauma genom att kasta sig in i kontorets helgfest, Christian ifrågasätter sin världsbild, och Jake överväger att lämna firman.

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdjurens jul
programme.desc: Tomten måste döda de onda djuren i South Park och rädda världen efter att de fått Stan att hjälpa dem med födelsen av deras frälsare.

programme.desc: När Alice vägrar ge killarna ledigt för fejkhögtiden 'halvjul' bestämmer de sig för att strejka för bättre arbetsvillkor.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Argument

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Vicky's Having Doubts

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Big Question
programme.desc: Det är snart slut på vårlovet när huset skakas av ännu en förlust. Ricci planerar att fria till Vicky, James och sköterskan Holly testar rullstolens fjädring och Charlotte hoppar i säng med Gary. Cancún har förändrat Geordie Shore-huset för alltid.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Geordie Shore Awards
programme.desc: Glöm EMA- och VMA-galan. MTV-priset alla vill ha är Geordie Shore Award. Vi anser att vårt Geordiegäng förtjänar ett pris för sitt hårda arbete. Först får kändisar och fans säga sitt, sen bestämmer vi vem som tar priset.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sleeping with the Enemy

programme.title: Jersey Shore: All in the Family

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Dirty Pad

programme.title: Klovn: Politikerveckan

programme.title: Klovn: Mias Fede Ferie

programme.title: Klovn: Vänstertricket

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dueling Magical Negroes

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again

programme.title: iCarly: Skoskav

programme.title: iCarly: Jag lovar att inte berätta

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly räddar TV

programme.title: iCarly: Jag hatar Sams pojkvän
programme.desc: Sam skaffar pojkvän, och de båda är oskiljaktiga. Men när förhållandet börjar påverka iCarly, inser Carly och Freddie att de måste göra något åt det.

programme.title: iCarly: Övervakning
programme.desc: Efter att ha sett ett inslag på iCarly som visade en man som säljer olagliga filmkopior, bestämmer sig två poliser för att använda Carlys och Spencers våning som en övervakningsplats.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag kanske byter skola
programme.desc: Carly får veta att hon på grund av sin webbshow, kan få möjlighet till ett heltäckande stipendium till den privata elitskolan Briarwood. Carly är inte så sugen på det, men Sam och Freddie vet att de måste få henne att ändra sig.

programme.title: iCarly: Fart och fäkt
programme.desc: Freddie behöver spendera tid med bara killar, så han följer med Spencer på fäktning. Freddie är en naturbegåvning, men saker och ting blir komplicerade när Spencer får honom involverad i en match mot den fantastiske Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en dejt
programme.desc: När deras vän Gibby är för blyg för att bjuda ut en tjej han gillar, bestämmer sig gänget för att göra honom och föremålet för hans kärlek till tävlande i ett "Vinn en dejt"-inslag i sin webbshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag såg honom först
programme.desc: När Carly och Sam blir intresserade av samma kille, lovar de att det inte ska komma emellan deras vänskap. Det här visar sig bli svårare än de trott och snart prövas deras vänskap medan de håller på och tävlar om hans uppmärksamhet.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Special
